map.园艺工具选用与保养 使用指南: Garden Tool Selection and Maintenance User Guide
map.按类别选用：铲（移植/松土）、修枝剪（ pruning 直径<2cm 枝条）、耙: Choose by category: trowel (transplanting/loosening soil), pruning shears (for branches under 2 cm in diameter), rake (levelling/gathering leaves), watering can/sprayer (irrigation); when buying look at material (stainless steel/carbon steel) and handle ergonomics. ...
map.工具清洁防锈保养: Tool cleaning and rust prevention maintenance
map.细砂纸/钢丝绒除锈后上油，活动关节滴润滑油；长期存放拆开、干燥、悬挂避免刃口磕碰: Remove rust with fine sandpaper or steel wool and then oil it, drip lubricating oil on moving joints; for long-term storage take it apart, dry it and hang it to avoid knocks to the edge
map.旁路式（bypass）切口平整适合活枝；砧式（anvil）适合枯枝。直径超 2c: A bypass cut is clean and suits live branches; an anvil type suits dead wood. For diameters over 2 cm switch to loppers or a saw.
map.工具生锈了怎么办？: What if a tool has rusted?
